decisions.literal_surviving_pretest_question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?
decisions.predetermined_answer: Only once. Moving the same Town into another land affected later by this Tsunami does not reset the single-Power, single-Invader limit.
minimum_required_facts: The same Town provides nightmare-destruction Fear only once during that single Tsunami use; moving it between affected lands does not reset the per-Power, per-Invader limit.

operative_text_entries.complete_operative_passage:
Can Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares combine Damage from multiple Powers - eg, use a "2 Damage" Power and a "1 Damage" Power to earn 5 Fear for an unhurt City?
(.7w4g7yx)
No. First the "2 Damage" Power resolves and does nothing (because that Power would not have destroyed an unhurt City). Then the "1 Damage" Power resolves and does nothing (because it would not have destroyed an unhurt City). Neither has any lingering effect of any kind.
If it were a
single Power
doing 2 Damage then 1 Damage, it would earn the Fear, because then that Power would have destroyed an unhurt City. For each Power Bringer uses, briefly imagine a universe where you resolve the entire Power normally. Whenever it would destroy an Invader in that universe, in the real game you earn 0/2/5 Fear and Push it if it's an Explorer or Town.

8. Elemental Thresholds: Optional effects which may only be used if the Spirit has gained

up”; the threshold is simply a check to see if they are in play. For instance, a Spirit with 2

resolve a Power as if you had fewer Elements than you actually do. Resolve the base effect   
 
and all threshold effects that you meet, in order from top to bottom.

operative_text_entries.locator: CORE p17 complete Do as much as you can and You can skip using a Power’s effect principles
operative_text_entries.complete_operative_passage:
DO AS MUCH AS YOU CAN
When resolving a Power’s effects, do as much as you can. If one part does not apply or cannot be 
done, skip it and do the rest. The only targeting restrictions are those in the target bar.
GENERAL PRINCIPLE: YOU CAN SKIP USING A POWER’S EFFECT
If you cannot or do not want to use a Power - perhaps the board situation has changed - you’re 
allowed to skip its effects entirely. If it was a Power Card, you don’t get your Energy back, but you 
do still get to use the Elements granted by the card.
When using a Power with thresholds, you may act as if you have fewer Elements than you really
do, to avoid hitting thresholds. Other than that, it’s all or nothing - you can’t pick-and-choose
instructions.

operative_text_entries.locator: CORE p19 complete Gather and Push section
operative_text_entries.complete_operative_passage:
GATHER AND PUSH
Some Powers tell you to Gather things into the target land (such as “Gather 1 
”, or “Gather up to
3 
”). This means “Move that many things into the target land from land(s) adjacent to it”. Gather 
only pulls things in from lands adjacent to the target; boosts to a Power’s Range do not affect
Gathering distance.
Other Powers tell you to Push things from the target land (such as “Push 1 ”, or “Push up to 3 
”). 
This is the exact reverse of Gather. It means “Move that many things out of the target land, to
adjacent land(s)”. Push only sends things one land away; boosts to a Power’s Range do not affect 
Pushing distance. If Pushing multiple things, they may go to different lands or not, as you wish. You 
can only Push into a valid land, not off the board or into the Ocean.

required_facts: Separate 2- and 1-Damage Bringer Powers each fail to pretend-destroy an undamaged City and leave no hypothetical Damage.
A single Power with 2 then 1 Damage combines its instructions and pretend-destroys that City for 5 Fear without actual destruction.

primary_source_refs.complete_operative_passage:
Can Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares combine Damage from multiple Powers - eg, use a "2 Damage" Power and a "1 Damage" Power to earn 5 Fear for an unhurt City?
(.7w4g7yx)
No. First the "2 Damage" Power resolves and does nothing (because that Power would not have destroyed an unhurt City). Then the "1 Damage" Power resolves and does nothing (because it would not have destroyed an unhurt City). Neither has any lingering effect of any kind.
If it were a
single Power
doing 2 Damage then 1 Damage, it would earn the Fear, because then that Power would have destroyed an unhurt City. For each Power Bringer uses, briefly imagine a universe where you resolve the entire Power normally. Whenever it would destroy an Invader in that universe, in the real game you earn 0/2/5 Fear and Push it if it's an Explorer or Town.

primary_source_refs.complete_operative_passage:
DO AS MUCH AS YOU CAN
When resolving a Power’s effects, do as much as you can. If one part does not apply or cannot be 
done, skip it and do the rest. The only targeting restrictions are those in the target bar.
GENERAL PRINCIPLE: YOU CAN SKIP USING A POWER’S EFFECT
If you cannot or do not want to use a Power - perhaps the board situation has changed - you’re 
allowed to skip its effects entirely. If it was a Power Card, you don’t get your Energy back, but you 
do still get to use the Elements granted by the card.
When using a Power with thresholds, you may act as if you have fewer Elements than you really
do, to avoid hitting thresholds. Other than that, it’s all or nothing - you can’t pick-and-choose
instructions.
